title: Accounts per customer
statementMd:
For every customer show the number of accounts they hold. Show only customers with 3 accounts.

Expected columns: `name`, `accounts`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS accounts FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) = 3;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
